verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt served with HTTP 200 at developer.visaacceptance.com, the developer center that hosts the Intelligent Commerce docs. Agent-readable markdown pages (e.g. agent-toolkit-intro.md) and a keylessly fetchable raw TAP README add further agent-oriented doc surfaces. Missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt specifically indexes the Intelligent Commerce API pages (the probe shows only its header), no llms.txt evidenced for developer.visa.com, and no independent or hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.
